business_problem: The city's property market is highly fragmented with many agents restricted to listings within their community.
solution_summary: House730 built its solution on Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry, Power Platform to automate high-friction work and turn enterprise data into faster decisions. The implementation combines cloud application services, data services, and AI capabilities so business users can search, summarize, analyze, or act on information through a single digital workflow instead of manual handoffs. It also connects with surrounding systems such as Property listings and agency feeds, which lets the new Azure-based workflow fit into existing operations rather than standing apart from them. As the first property search engine to capitalize upon Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service's natural language processing in Hong Kong, House730 helps more people house-hunt for their perfect property.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language model inference for summarization, extraction, conversational AI, and grounded answers.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Foundry
solution_components.role: Provides the managed environment for model orchestration, experimentation, and responsible AI operations.

solution_components.name: Power Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code automation and application platform for workflow modernization.

data_flow: Content and operational context are prepared in the application data layer, passed to Azure OpenAI for generation or extraction, stored in Azure storage services, and returned through the user-facing application to employees or customers with grounded responses.
